farfarplayer.options.title: Far Far Player
farfarplayer.options.enabled.tooltip: Draw other players past the range where the server stops sending them. The toggle key flips this too.
farfarplayer.options.showVehicles.toolti: Draw the horse, boat or happy ghast a distant player was last seen riding.
farfarplayer.options.offlinePose.tooltip: How a player who logged off is shown where they were last.
Without the data pack: how long a player stays where they were once the locator bar loses them (sneaking, another dimension).
farfarplayer.options.glowOutline.tooltip: A glowing outline around distant players and mobs, seen through terrain.
farfarplayer.options.renderTrackedVehicl: The game hides small entities early: a friend in a boat would float on nothing. Keeps a mount carrying a player drawn.
farfarplayer.options.distantMobs.tooltip: Animals, villagers and golems stay visible once out of range, where they were, with a small looping animation. No AI.
farfarplayer.options.maxDistantMobs.tool: How many remembered mobs are drawn at once: the nearest ones. Lower it if the game slows down.
farfarplayer.options.voxyOcclusion.toolt: Distant mobs and players are hidden by Voxy terrain pixel by pixel, like behind any block: half behind a tree, half visible. Needed with shader packs such as Photon, which keep Voxy out of the depth buffer.
farfarplayer.options.extendFarPlane.tool: The game clips everything past four times the render distance. On: pushed back to the farthest player. Off: those are drawn closer and smaller, and show through terrain.
farfarplayer.options.minApparentPixels.t: Above 0, a distant player or mob is never drawn smaller than this many pixels, and so looks bigger than it is far away.
farfarplayer.status.none: No other player is being followed.
farfarplayer.status.pack.on: Data pack: running, positions are exact.
farfarplayer.status.pack.off: Data pack: not found, positions come from the locator bar.
farfarplayer.status.cost: Cost: %s ms per tick, %s ms per frame; %s puppets drawn, %s skipped (behind you or too small).
farfarplayer.voxy.missing: Voxy is not installed: nothing to hide behind.
farfarplayer.voxy.probe.hit: Looking ahead, Voxy's first block is %s blocks away.
farfarplayer.voxy.probe.none: Looking ahead, Voxy knows no block within 4096 blocks.
farfarplayer.options.rememberNamedMobs.t: A mob with a name tag is remembered and shown whatever its type.
farfarplayer.options.chooseMobs.tooltip: Which mobs and boats are shown far away, one by one.
farfarplayer.options.forgetMobs.tooltip: Forgets every remembered mob on this server. The data pack's come back by themselves.
farfarplayer.options.forgetMobs.confirm: Every mob remembered on this server is forgotten. Mobs published by the data pack will come back; the others only once met again.
farfarplayer.options.forgetSleepers.tool: Removes every player shown asleep where they logged off, on this server.
farfarplayer.options.forgetSleepers.conf: Every player shown asleep on this server disappears. With the data pack, they come back from their last position.
farfarplayer.options.mobTypes.title: Mobs and boats shown far away
farfarplayer.options.mobTypes.shared.too: %s - ★ published by the data pack: shown even if you never met it. Animated: walks a little loop. Still: stays where it was.
farfarplayer.options.mobTypes.local.tool: %s - not in the data pack: shown only where you met it yourself. Animated: walks a little loop. Still: stays where it was.
farfarplayer.options.skyBirds.tooltip: Birds and bats around you: flocks, birds of prey, gulls, pigeons, robins, tits, bats at night. Only on your screen.
farfarplayer.options.birdMaxDistance.too: How far away birds can be, in blocks. Far birds are a few pixels, like real ones.
farfarplayer.options.birdDensity.tooltip: How many birds, all kinds together: 100 is the usual, 200 twice as many, 0 none.
farfarplayer.options.birdMinHeight.toolt: Blocks above you, or the sea when it is higher, below which flocks and birds of prey never fly.
farfarplayer.options.chooseBirds.tooltip: Which kinds of birds there are, one by one.
farfarplayer.options.birdTypes.title: Birds
farfarplayer.options.birdTypes.flocks.to: Clouds of small birds crossing the sky, far away.
farfarplayer.options.birdTypes.geese.too: Large birds flying high in a V.
farfarplayer.options.birdTypes.raptors.t: Large birds circling a spot, gliding, drifting with the wind.
farfarplayer.options.birdTypes.gulls.too: White birds low over beaches and the sea; now and then one lands on the beach, and takes off if you come close.
farfarplayer.options.birdTypes.pigeons.t: Sitting on the top of tall buildings; they take off when you come close and land again later.
farfarplayer.options.birdTypes.robins.to: Hopping and pecking in fields of crops; they fly off when you come close.
farfarplayer.options.birdTypes.tits.tool: Flitting about the tops of trees.
farfarplayer.options.birdTypes.ducks.too: On lakes, rivers and ponds; now and then they fly to another spot. They never let you come near.
farfarplayer.options.birdTypes.bats.tool: At night, flitting around the scenery, or hanging upside down under leaves and roofs near you until you come close. They go home at dawn.
farfarplayer.options.birdTypes.parrots.t: Now and then a flock of the game's parrots.
farfarplayer.options.ufo.tooltip: An easter egg: now and then, far away, a flying saucer comes for a cow. Only on your screen. /farfarplayer ufo calls it now.
farfarplayer.options.birdSize.tooltip: How much bigger than life the birds are drawn. 1 is true to life.
farfarplayer.options.hideOccludedMobs.to: Distant mobs hidden behind terrain (Voxy's included) are not drawn at all, instead of drawn and covered pixel by pixel. Cheaper with many mobs, but a mob half behind a hill disappears too, and one shows up a moment after the view clears. Needs Voxy.
farfarplayer.options.debug.tooltip: Boxes and labels on distant mobs, a panel of counts and costs, the depth buffer with Voxy, and a switch for every optimisation.
farfarplayer.options.debugHud.tooltip: Top left: cost per tick and frame, what became of every distant mob in the last frame, Voxy reads and depth, how far this server sends mobs, which optimisations are on.
farfarplayer.options.debugBoxes.tooltip: A box and a dot around every distant mob and player, seen through terrain, in the colour of what became of it: green copy drawn, cyan real mob drawn by the mod, blue player, yellow too small, orange behind blocks, red outside the view, purple being built, grey past the maximum.
farfarplayer.options.debugLabels.tooltip: Over each box: what became of it, its kind, its distance and its size on screen in pixels.
farfarplayer.options.debugGameMobs.toolt: White boxes around the mobs the game draws itself, to see where the mod takes over.
farfarplayer.options.debugDepthView.tool: The depth buffer in the bottom right corner, near white to far black, the sky in blue.
farfarplayer.options.optViewCulling.tool: Copies behind you or to the side are not prepared at all.
farfarplayer.options.optTinyCulling.tool: Copies smaller than about half a pixel are not prepared (only at true size, minimum size 0).
farfarplayer.options.optLazyVoxyDepth.to: Voxy's depth is merged only on frames that draw something past the render distance. Off: every frame.
farfarplayer.options.optParallelVoxy.too: Voxy's world is read on several threads at once. Off: one thread.
farfarplayer.options.optColumnCache.tool: Ground already read in Voxy's world is kept two minutes. Off: read again every time.
Saved mobs are read off the game's thread and built within 2 ms per tick. Off: all at once, on the game's thread.
farfarplayer.debug.on: Far Far Player debug: on (panel and boxes).
farfarplayer.debug.hud.title: Far Far Player - debug
farfarplayer.debug.hud.mobs: Mobs: %s remembered, %s chosen, %s built, %s waiting, %s sent by the server
farfarplayer.debug.hud.voxy: Voxy reads: %s threads, %s tasks pending, %s columns known
